title: SatGate Receipt v1
description: Canonical schema for SatGate receipt artifacts. Receipts are decision evidence emitted by issuers and acceptors after allowed, denied, delegated, revoked, or paid decisions.

evidence_pack_id.description: Evidence Pack this receipt rolls into.

issuer.description: Trusted HTTPS issuer origin used for JWKS discovery after trust-anchor validation. No path, query, or fragment.

issuer_kid.description: Issuer signing-key id used to select from issuer JWKS.

acceptor_id.description: HTTPS upstream acceptor identity when the receipt is bound to an accepting API. Query and fragment are not allowed.

amount_usd.description: Positive USD amount for paid receipts.

receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hash over the RFC 8785 canonical payload bytes, excluding receipt_hash and signature.

signature.description: Ed25519 issuer signature over the RFC 8785 canonical payload bytes, excluding receipt_hash and signature.

canonicalization.description: Canonical payload uses JSON Canonicalization Scheme (RFC 8785), excluding receipt_hash and signature fields.

hash_algorithm.description: receipt_hash is SHA-256 over the canonical payload bytes excluding receipt_hash and signature.

signature_algorithm.description: SatGate receipt v1 signature profile. The selected issuer JWK must be Ed25519-compatible.

currency.description: Currency for amount_usd; fixed to USD in v1 when amount_usd is used.

settlement_reference.description: Optional rail or ledger settlement reference for paid receipts.

task_id.description: Optional correlation id for the user/principal task this receipt helps prove.

task_status.description: Optional task lifecycle state observed by a verifier or gateway.

attempt.description: Optional 1-based attempt number for loop/retry analysis.

max_attempts.description: Optional policy or verifier retry ceiling for the correlated task/action.

retry_of_receipt_id.description: Optional prior receipt id when this receipt is a retry or loop continuation.

parent_receipt_id.description: Optional parent receipt id for delegation, attenuation, revocation, or chained execution evidence.

budget_id.description: Optional budget ledger identifier used to prove stayed-within-budget later.

budget_limit_usd.description: Optional USD budget ceiling observed for this decision.

principal_id.description: Optional human/principal/service identity that authorized, delegated, vouched, or revoked authority.

principal_authorization_id.description: Optional id for the principal authorization or vouch event behind this decision.

vouch_receipt_id.description: Optional receipt id that records a principal vouch. This is evidence, not a score.

attenuation_depth.description: Optional observed attenuation/delegation depth at this decision.

caveats_hash.description: Optional hash of effective caveats/scopes without leaking raw credential material.

revoked_receipt_id.description: Optional receipt id for the revocation event this decision enforces or proves.

event_history_ref.description: Optional Evidence Pack or event stream reference used for verifier-observed history.
